root: ^We have faced a grave danger to our cause in the new lands you visited earlier. This is the reason for today's Letter. For a correct approach to this Letter, it will be useful to remember our methods, passages and objectives.

^It has come to our attention that our Holy Relics have been defiled by someone or something. Our soldiers have guarded them but speak of malicious and ill-intentioned spirits that have taken over. Thus, we have gathered items for a purification ritual. Verbal compponent is the most important part which we'll remind you of next:
^1. Purify and seal the area with Blessed Salts
^2. Pray to our Holy One and find your Apostles
^3. Renounce the evil and cast it out
^Use Holy Water and other symbols if necessary. Do not deviate from these brother even though Apostles do.

^The Church, in fidelity to the will of the Creator, is striving to become ever more a "family", and the Apostolic See is committed to encouraging this growth. We must act accordingly and you're an integral part of this mission.
^All praise to the Most Holy! I greet you, redeemed by the Precious Scripture!
^the Servants of the Blessed in the year of Lamb
